No user-visible changes in this version.

- No file changes were detected.
- Functionality, triggers, and workflow remain as previously described.

Lazada Shopping Assistant v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Lazada cross-site shopping assistant.
- Guides users from shopping intent to purchase on Lazada regional sites (SG, MY, ID, TH, PH, VN).
- Detects country/site, clarifies user intent and scenarios, generates targeted search queries.
- Scrapes Lazada search results live via browser automation and presents ranked product recommendations with rationale.
- Works in any agent environment with browser automation support; includes clear browser tool setup and fallback instructions.
- Outputs clickable product links, prices, sold counts, shipping origin, and highlights best/alternative/budget picks.
